description: Test harness for monitoring WhatsApp inbox, including mock setup, utility functions, and test hooks.

classes.name: MockSock
classes.description: Mock representation of a WhatsApp socket with event emitter and message handling functions.

methods.name: createResolvedMock
methods.description: Creates a mock function that resolves to undefined.

methods.name: createMockSock
methods.description: Creates a mock socket object with event emitter and mock functions.

methods.name: getSock
methods.description: Returns the current mock WhatsApp socket, throws if not initialized.

methods.name: expectInboxPairingReplyText
methods.description: Validates the pairing reply text contains expected codes and info.

methods.name: getMonitorWebInbox
methods.description: Returns the monitorWebInbox function, throws if not initialized.

methods.name: settleInboundWork
methods.description: Waits briefly to settle inbound message processing.

methods.name: waitForMessageCalls
methods.description: Waits until a message handler has been called a specified number of times.

methods.name: startInboxMonitor
methods.description: Starts monitoring the inbox with specified message handler and options.

methods.name: buildNotifyMessageUpsert
methods.description: Builds a notification message object for upsert operations.

methods.name: expectPairingPromptSent
methods.description: Asserts that a pairing prompt message was sent via socket.

methods.name: getAuthDir
methods.description: Returns the authentication directory path, throws if not initialized.

methods.name: installWebMonitorInboxUnitTestHooks
methods.description: Sets up test hooks for web monitor inbox, including mocks and cleanup.
